exposure: Antithrombin activity level at diagnosis of pre-eclampsia
outcome: Interval from diagnosis of pre-eclampsia to delivery
cohort: The study included 94 women with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with pre-eclampsia (defined by combined gestational hypertension and proteinuria) at Hokkaido University Hospital, 38 of whom had early-onset pre-eclampsia.
finding: An antithrombin activity cutoff of 78% at the diagnosis of early-onset pre-eclampsia was identified as optimal for predicting delivery within 7 days.
